datasets.name: ds_velocity
queryLines: SELECT `Sprint` AS sprint_name, `Sprint State` AS state, `Project Key` AS project_key, `Start Date` AS start_date, `Complete Date` AS complete_date, MEASURE(`Points Planned`) AS points_in_sprint, MEASURE(`Points Completed`) AS points_completed, MEASURE(`Avg Completion Ratio`) AS completion_ratio, MEASURE(`Issues Planned`) AS issues_in_sprint, MEASURE(`Issues Completed`) AS issues_completed, CASE WHEN `Sprint State` = 'active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_active, CASE WHEN `Complete Date` >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS THEN MEASURE(`Points Completed`) ELSE 0 END AS points_completed_30d FROM `{dashboard_catalog}`.`{dashboard_schema}`.metric_sprint_velocity GROUP BY `Sprint`, `Sprint State`, `Project Key`, `Start Date`, `Complete Date`

datasets.name: ds_velocity_recent
queryLines: SELECT `Sprint` AS sprint_name, `Sprint State` AS state, `Project Key` AS project_key, `Start Date` AS start_date, `Complete Date` AS complete_date, MEASURE(`Points Planned`) AS points_in_sprint, MEASURE(`Points Completed`) AS points_completed, MEASURE(`Avg Completion Ratio`) AS completion_ratio, MEASURE(`Issues Planned`) AS issues_in_sprint, MEASURE(`Issues Completed`) AS issues_completed, MEASURE(`Points Planned`) - MEASURE(`Points Completed`) AS carryover_points FROM `{dashboard_catalog}`.`{dashboard_schema}`.metric_sprint_velocity WHERE `Sprint State` = 'closed' AND `Complete Date` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `Sprint`, `Sprint State`, `Project Key`, `Start Date`, `Complete Date` ORDER BY `Complete Date` DESC LIMIT 12

datasets.name: ds_velocity_series
queryLines: SELECT `Sprint` AS sprint_name, `Project Key` AS project_key, `Complete Date` AS complete_date, 'Planned' AS series, MEASURE(`Points Planned`) AS points FROM `{dashboard_catalog}`.`{dashboard_schema}`.metric_sprint_velocity WHERE `Sprint State` = 'closed' AND `Complete Date` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `Sprint`, `Project Key`, `Complete Date` UNION ALL SELECT `Sprint` AS sprint_name, `Project Key` AS project_key, `Complete Date` AS complete_date, 'Completed' AS series, MEASURE(`Points Completed`) AS points FROM `{dashboard_catalog}`.`{dashboard_schema}`.metric_sprint_velocity WHERE `Sprint State` = 'closed' AND `Complete Date` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `Sprint`, `Project Key`, `Complete Date`

datasets.name: ds_issue
queryLines: SELECT `Issue Key` AS issue_key, `Summary` AS summary, `Project Key` AS project_key, `Assignee` AS assignee_name, `Priority` AS priority, `Age (days)` AS age_days, `Status Category` AS status_category, `Issue Type` AS issue_type, `Is Resolved` AS is_resolved, `Cycle Time (days)` AS cycle_time_days, `Lead Time (days)` AS lead_time_days, `Age Bucket` AS age_bucket FROM `{dashboard_catalog}`.`{dashboard_schema}`.metric_issue

datasets.name: ds_issue_open
queryLines: SELECT `Issue Key` AS issue_key, `Summary` AS summary, `Project Key` AS project_key, `Assignee` AS assignee_name, `Priority` AS priority, `Age (days)` AS age_days, `Status Category` AS status_category, `Issue Type` AS issue_type, `Is Resolved` AS is_resolved, `Cycle Time (days)` AS cycle_time_days, `Lead Time (days)` AS lead_time_days, `Age Bucket` AS age_bucket, CASE WHEN `Age (days)` > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_stale_open, CASE WHEN `Age (days)` > 30 AND `Priority` IN ('Highest','Critical','Blocker') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_stale_critical, CASE WHEN `Is Unassigned` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_unassigned, CASE WHEN `Is Overdue` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_overdue, CASE WHEN `Is WIP` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_wip FROM `{dashboard_catalog}`.`{dashboard_schema}`.metric_issue WHERE NOT `Is Resolved`

datasets.name: ds_issue_kpi
queryLines: SELECT `Project Key` AS project_key, MEASURE(`Open Issues`) AS open_issues, MEASURE(`Open Critical`) AS open_critical, MEASURE(`WIP Issues`) AS wip_issues, MEASURE(`Unassigned Open`) AS unassigned_open, MEASURE(`Overdue Open`) AS overdue_open, MEASURE(`Created (30d)`) AS created_30d, MEASURE(`Resolved (30d)`) AS resolved_30d, MEASURE(`Created (30d)`) - MEASURE(`Resolved (30d)`) AS net_backlog_30d FROM `{dashboard_catalog}`.`{dashboard_schema}`.metric_issue GROUP BY `Project Key`

datasets.name: ds_issue_resolved_180
queryLines: SELECT `Issue Key` AS issue_key, `Summary` AS summary, `Project Key` AS project_key, `Assignee` AS assignee_name, `Priority` AS priority, `Age (days)` AS age_days, `Status Category` AS status_category, `Issue Type` AS issue_type, `Is Resolved` AS is_resolved, `Cycle Time (days)` AS cycle_time_days, `Lead Time (days)` AS lead_time_days, `Age Bucket` AS age_bucket, CASE WHEN `Cycle Time (days)` < 1 THEN '< 1d' WHEN `Cycle Time (days)` < 3 THEN '1-3d' WHEN `Cycle Time (days)` < 7 THEN '3-7d' WHEN `Cycle Time (days)` < 14 THEN '7-14d' WHEN `Cycle Time (days)` < 30 THEN '14-30d' WHEN `Cycle Time (days)` < 60 THEN '30-60d' WHEN `Cycle Time (days)` < 90 THEN '60-90d' ELSE '90d+' END AS cycle_bucket FROM `{dashboard_catalog}`.`{dashboard_schema}`.metric_issue WHERE `Is Resolved` AND `Resolved Date` >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 180 DAYS

datasets.name: ds_issue_medians
queryLines: SELECT `Project Key` AS project_key, approx_percentile(`Cycle Time (days)`, 0.5) AS median_cycle, approx_percentile(`Lead Time (days)`, 0.5) AS median_lead FROM `{dashboard_catalog}`.`{dashboard_schema}`.metric_issue WHERE `Is Resolved` AND `Resolved Date` >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 180 DAYS GROUP BY `Project Key`

datasets.name: ds_project_health
queryLines: SELECT `Project Key` AS project_key, `Project Name` AS project_name, MEASURE(`Open Issues`) AS open_issues, MEASURE(`Open Critical`) AS open_critical, MEASURE(`Stale Open`) AS stale_open, MEASURE(`Avg Cycle Time (days)`) AS avg_cycle_time_days, MEASURE(`Resolved Issues (30d)`) AS resolved_last_30d, MEASURE(`Created Issues (30d)`) AS created_last_30d, MEASURE(`Net Backlog Change (30d)`) AS net_backlog_30d, MEASURE(`Flow Ratio (30d)`) AS flow_ratio_30d, CASE WHEN MEASURE(`Stale Open`) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_stale FROM `{dashboard_catalog}`.`{dashboard_schema}`.metric_project_health GROUP BY `Project Key`, `Project Name`

datasets.name: ds_assignee_load
queryLines: SELECT `Assignee` AS assignee_name, `Project Key` AS project_key, `Priority` AS priority, MEASURE(`Open Issues`) AS open_issues FROM `{dashboard_catalog}`.`{dashboard_schema}`.metric_assignee_load GROUP BY `Assignee`, `Project Key`, `Priority`

datasets.name: ds_team_prod
queryLines: SELECT `Assignee` AS assignee_name, MEASURE(`Resolved (30d)`) AS resolved_30d, MEASURE(`Resolved (90d)`) AS resolved_90d, MEASURE(`Open Now`) AS open_now, MEASURE(`Open Critical`) AS open_critical, MEASURE(`Avg Cycle Time (days)`) AS avg_cycle_time_days, MEASURE(`Avg Lead Time (days)`) AS avg_lead_time_days, CASE WHEN MEASURE(`Resolved (30d)`) > 0 OR MEASURE(`Open Now`) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_active_contributor FROM `{dashboard_catalog}`.`{dashboard_schema}`.metric_team_productivity GROUP BY `Assignee`

datasets.name: ds_time_in_status
queryLines: SELECT `Project Key` AS project_key, `Status` AS status_name, MEASURE(`P50 Duration (hours)`) AS p50_hours, MEASURE(`P90 Duration (hours)`) AS p90_hours, MEASURE(`Observations`) AS observations FROM `{dashboard_catalog}`.`{dashboard_schema}`.metric_time_in_status GROUP BY `Project Key`, `Status`

datasets.name: ds_flow_weekly
queryLines: SELECT `Flow Week` AS flow_week, `Project Key` AS project_key, MEASURE(`Created Issues`) AS created_issues, MEASURE(`Resolved Issues`) AS resolved_issues, MEASURE(`Net Backlog Change`) AS net_change FROM `{dashboard_catalog}`.`{dashboard_schema}`.metric_flow WHERE `Flow Date` >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 84 DAYS GROUP BY `Flow Week`, `Project Key`

datasets.name: ds_flow_series
queryLines: SELECT `Flow Week` AS flow_week, `Project Key` AS project_key, 'Created' AS series, MEASURE(`Created Issues`) AS issues FROM `{dashboard_catalog}`.`{dashboard_schema}`.metric_flow WHERE `Flow Date` >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 84 DAYS GROUP BY `Flow Week`, `Project Key` UNION ALL SELECT `Flow Week` AS flow_week, `Project Key` AS project_key, 'Resolved' AS series, MEASURE(`Resolved Issues`) AS issues FROM `{dashboard_catalog}`.`{dashboard_schema}`.metric_flow WHERE `Flow Date` >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 84 DAYS GROUP BY `Flow Week`, `Project Key`

datasets.name: ds_worklog
queryLines: SELECT `Project Key` AS project_key, `Author` AS author_name, MEASURE(`Hours (30d)`) AS hours_30d, MEASURE(`Total Hours`) AS total_hours FROM `{dashboard_catalog}`.`{dashboard_schema}`.metric_worklog GROUP BY `Project Key`, `Author`
